items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Hymie Shertzer was there from the original band

ctx.x: The original band, let's see, Hymie Shertzer was there from the original band, and I think Vernon Brown was there from the original band, and Gene Krupa. On the bass was George Duviver, and I think Allen Reuss, the original guitar player, was there. The original bass player with Goodman, of course, was Harry Goodman, Benny's older brother.

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the reeds would be Hymie Schertzer on alto

ctx.x: And the trombones would be Red Ballard and Vernon Brown, the reeds would be Hymie Schertzer on alto and probably George Koenig: Bill DePew on third alto, the tenor would have been Babe Rusin or Bud Freeman or Vico Muso and Arthur Rollini, Adrian's younger brother. That would have been the real personnel. And of course, Stacey on the piano.
